description: This Java class 'SensorStats' provides static methods for measuring and processing sensor data in a system, including range measurement, standard deviation calculation, delta calculation between sensors, and value conversion.

classes.name: SensorStats
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for computing sensor data statistics such as range, standard deviation, delta, and conversion.

methods.name: startRangeMeasurement
methods.description: Sets up a listener to measure the range (max - min) of sensor 'source' over each 10 updates and posts the value to 'widthDestination'.

methods.name: startStandardDeviation
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of 'source' sensor readings over a buffer of recent values and posts the result to 'destination'.

methods.name: startDelta
methods.description: Measures the difference between two sensors' readings, normalizes it by system ticks per millisecond, and posts to 'destination'.

methods.name: startConversion
methods.description: Converts sensor 'source' values using a provided conversion object and posts the result to 'destination'.
